NIIMBOT's two best-selling 300 dpi label makers: the $99.99 M2 thermal transfer printer vs the $69.99 B21 Pro inkless printer. Full comparison: https://wisechoicekr.com/best/niimbot-m2-vs-b21-pro/

scenes.title: NIIMBOT M2 or B21 Pro?
scenes.say: NIIMBOT's two best selling label makers. The M2 for ninety nine ninety nine, or the B21 Pro for sixty nine ninety nine.

scenes.title: Both 300 dpi, both 2-inch
scenes.say: Both print at three hundred d p i, on labels up to two inches wide, and run four hours on a charge from your phone or computer.

scenes.title: Ribbons for labels that last
scenes.say: The M2 uses ribbons, so labels resist water, oil and sun, and you can print in seven colors. NIIMBOT says they last eight to ten years.

scenes.title: No ribbon, plus photos
scenes.say: The B21 Pro needs no ink or ribbon, prints fast, and can do small photo stickers. Thermal labels can fade over time, though.

scenes.title: Strict store rules
scenes.say: Heads up. NIIMBOT's store doesn't allow cancellations, returns are at your cost, and the warranty length isn't stated.
